'''Tomáš Zima''' (born 2 July 1966) is a [[Czechs|Czech]] medical doctor and chemist. He is a university professor in the fields of biochemistry, clinical chemistry and laboratory medicine. He was the [[List of Charles University rectors|Rector of Charles University]] in [[Prague]] in 2014–2022 and was a candidate in the [[2023 Czech presidential election]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=France-Presse |first=Agence |date=2023-01-13 |title=3 Frontrunners as Czechs Vote for New President |url=https://www.voanews.com/a/frontrunners-as-czechs-vote-for-new-president-/6916826.html |access-date=2026-09-25 |website=Voice of America |language=en}}</ref>

==Academic career==
Zima graduated from the [[First Faculty of Medicine, Charles University|First Faculty of Medicine]] of [[Charles University]] in 1990. He has been a professor of [[medicinal chemistry|medical chemistry]] and [[biochemistry]] since 2001 and head of the Institute of Medical Biochemistry and Laboratory Medicine of the First Faculty of Medicine and General University Hospital, Prague. He is a specialist in clinical chemistry, and European Specialist in Laboratory Medicine (EuSpLM). He was the Dean of the First Faculty of Medicine from 2005 to 2012 and then became Rector of the university.<ref name="Životopis">{{Cite web|date=2012-08-28|title=Životopis|url=https://www.tomaszima.cz/zivotopis/|access-date=2022-02-15|website=prof. MUDr. Tomáš Zima, DrSc.|language=cs}}</ref> He was visiting professor [[Università degli Studi di Milano]] in 2024.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Životopis |url=https://tomaszima.cz/zivotopis/ |access-date=2026-09-25 |website=prof. MUDr. Tomáš Zima, DrSc. |language=cs}}</ref>

His main research interests include [[oxidative stress]], [[advanced glycation end-product]]s (AGEs), experimental [[nephrology]], [[tumor marker]]s, and laboratory management and accreditation.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Vědecká činnost |url=https://tomaszima.cz/vedecka-cinnost/ |access-date=2026-09-25 |website=prof. MUDr. Tomáš Zima, DrSc. |language=cs}}</ref> He is the author of more than 550 articles, which are cited more than 7000 times in the [[Science Citation Index]], eleven books and co-author of 71 chapters in books, with an [[H-index]] of 35. He has given more than 130 lectures outside the Czech Republic.

Zima is a member of several scientific societies, including the [[Czech Medical Academy]] and [[Czech Learned Society]] and serves on Boards including the executive board of EFLM,{{clarify|date=April 2017}} and the Conferences and Congresses Committee of the [[International Federation of Clinical Chemistry and Laboratory Medicine]]. He is a member of the [[European Commission]]'s Scientific Panel for Health (SPH).<ref name="Životopis" />

==Entry into politics==
Tomáš Zima was a candidate in the [[2023 Czech presidential election]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.irozhlas.cz/volby/prezidentske-volby-babis-fischer-hilser-zima-senatorri-poslanci-podpisy_2211010630_jgr|title=Poslanci ANO vyšlou do boje o Hrad Babiše, senátoři Zimu. Zákonodárci z jedné strany se často neshodnou|website=iROZHLAS|date=November 2022 }}</ref> He finished last of eight candidates in the first round on 14 January 2023, with 0.55%.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Matoušek |first1=Tomáš |title=Zima: Koho podpořím, zatím neřeknu, Senát nevylučuji. V pondělí jdu zase do práce|url=https://www.idnes.cz/volby/kandidat-tomas-zima-volebni-stab-prezidentske-volby-2023.A230114_102524_volby_imat|website=idnes.cz|access-date=15 January 2023|language=cs|date=14 January 2023}}</ref>

==Political views==
During his presidential campaign, Zima voiced his support for the [[right to keep and bear arms]], describing it as a "matter of principle" for him.<ref name="candidates poll">{{cite web|title=Postoje prezidentských kandidátů k civilnímu držení zbraní|url=https://zbrojnice.com/2022/12/03/postoje-prezidentskych-kandidatu-k-civilnimu-drzeni-zbrani/|website=zbrojnice.com |accessdate=3 December 2022|language=cs-CZ|date=3 December 2022}}</ref> Zima said he owns two [[Česká zbrojovka Uherský Brod|CZ pistols]]<ref name="zima-guns" /> and trains in [[defensive gun use]] at a shooting range.<ref name="zima-guns">{{cite web|title=Zbraně & Tomáš Zima, exrektor Univerzity Karlovy a kandidát na prezidenta|url=https://zbrojnice.com/2022/12/03/postoje-prezidentskych-kandidatu-k-civilnimu-drzeni-zbrani/|website=zbrojnice.com |accessdate=10 December 2022|language=cs-CZ|date=10 December 2022}}</ref> He further commented that "any greater restrictions would be to the detriment of issues related to the protection of the freedom of individuals, but also of the state", stating that as president, he would veto restrictions on the legal possession of firearms by civilians.<ref name="candidates poll" />
